notes.title: GET READY FOR RELEASE DAY!
notes.notes:
GAME LAUNCH ANNOUNCEMENT: TAKEN SOUL AT 9AM ON 08.03.2024 (CST)

No more waiting and longing day by day, as Taken Soul officially sets its launch for:
12PM noon on 07.03.2024 (+7)
9AM ON 08.03.2024 (CST)
Taken Soul promising to bring a fresh and exciting experience, with a story and game world deeply imbued with Vietnamese culture.

Players will not only meet and explore Da Lat through the game, but you will also enjoy fascinating live streams from both local and international streamers. They will directly experience and live stream Taken Soul on various platforms on the launch day, providing a visual and authentic look at the game, as well as sharing their genuine reactions and emotions while uncovering the mysteries of Da Lat from the game's perspective.

The launch event of Taken Soul is not just a significant milestone for SOGA Studio and the Vietnamese gaming industry, but also an opportunity for the Vietnamese and international gaming communities to support and experience a quality game product.

If you have any other idol streamer that you would like to join the live stream on the launch day of Taken Soul, leave a comment!
